title: HubSpot Marketing Hub pricing - Free tier through $3,600/month Enterprise bundle
clean_text: HubSpot Marketing Hub has four published tiers: Free ($0), Starter (around $20 per seat per month on annual billing, includes 1,000 marketing contacts, with additional contacts at $50/month per 1,000), Professional (about $890/month on annual billing, 2,000 contacts, 3 seats), and Enterprise (about $3,600/month on annual billing, 10,000 contacts, 5 seats, additional seats $75/month each). Professional and Enterprise plans also carry one-time onboarding fees of $3,000 and $7,000 respectively. Monthly (non-annual) billing is available at higher rates on Starter and some Professional configurations.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, seat and contact-volume based
